summary.ru: Вторая Испанская Республика — республиканский период после низложения монархии до установления диктатуры Франсиско Франко с 1931 по 1939 год.
summary.en: The Spanish Republic, commonly known as the Second Spanish Republic, was the democratic government of Spain from 1931 to 1939. The Republic was proclaimed on 14 April 1931 after the deposition of King Alfonso XIII. It was dissolved on 1 April 1939 after surrendering in the Spanish Civil War to the Nationalists rebels led by General Francisco Franco.
